checks.explanation: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) revenue reached a record $29 billion in the following quarter (Q1 FY2027, reported May 2026), up 181% year-over-year - well beyond the roughly 100% growth Dell guided to on the show, driven by explosive AI server demand.

Trump Accounts (Invest America) officially launched on July 4, 2026 with about 6 million children signed up - well short of Gerstner's 10 million target - and signups reached roughly 7 million by late July, still below the predicted figure by the July 4 deadline.

sources.title: Trump Account signups reach 7 million - Bessent says it's 'the most successful launch in government history'
Trump Account signups now total more than 6 million, but millions more children are eligible
